concepts.name: Brick walk-up
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first apartment environment concept for The Picture Shop, a 2D management game.
Input image 1 is the game's approved warehouse. Use it strictly as the visual style/camera/material reference. Transform the subject completely into a small residential apartment. Preserve the illustrated semi-realistic game-background look, elevated three-quarter camera, crisp detailed surfaces, warm practical lighting, soft ambient shading, and readable floor planes. Do not reproduce warehouse equipment or office furniture.
Create one full landscape 1536x1024 concept of the CHEAPEST STARTER APARTMENT: an old shabby BRICK WALK-UP. Full roofless cutaway apartment fills most of the frame, all spaces clearly visible, with a discreet neutral dark exterior beyond the unit. Lower/remove the foreground walls and cut down internal walls enough to see and navigate each room.
The compact apartment must have exactly one open living area at front-left, a galley kitchen along the right side, one separate empty bedroom at back-left, one small separate bathroom at back-right, one tiny distinct clothes closet beside the bedroom, and a front entry connected to every room by usable door openings. There must be clear circulation and enough empty floor to later place furniture.
Quality: visibly worn and inexpensive but habitable. Old exposed brown brick, patched yellowed plaster, chipped paint, scratched dull wood, cheap patched tan vinyl in the kitchen, dated off-white bathroom tiles, old basic fixtures, modest windows. No structural collapse, rubble, severe mold, garbage, graffiti, or horror atmosphere.
UNFURNISHED default: absolutely no bed, couch, chairs, tables, desks, fridge, stove, wardrobes, rugs, freestanding shelves, decorations, or floor lamps. Keep living room and bedroom genuinely bare. Fixed fixtures only: one kitchen sink in a short simple worn laminate counter, one bathroom sink, one toilet, one combined tub/shower, one old compact stacked washer/dryer in a utility nook, plain empty closet rail. The only movable belonging is ONE small open laptop sitting on the dry end of the kitchen sink counter, safely separated from the basin. Leave a visibly empty appliance bay for a future stove and refrigerator. Include modest installed ceiling/wall lights.
This is a coherent usable floor plan, not a collage, furniture catalog, exploded diagram, or luxurious dollhouse. No people, no animals, no lettering, no room labels, no price labels, no logos, no watermark, no HUD. Grounding and texture should match the warehouse reference. No pixelation filter. Show the entire apartment without cropping any room.

concepts.name: Courtyard apartment — furnished option
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: optional modest-furnished starter apartment concept for The Picture Shop.
Edit the supplied COURTYARD apartment concept. Preserve EXACTLY its camera, framing, complete floor plan, walls, door openings, windows, floors, wear level, bathroom fixtures, washer/dryer, closet, front entry, kitchen counter and lighting. It must remain recognizably the same apartment, not a redesign.
Add only a very restrained cheap starter furnishing package, each object correctly grounded and sized for these rooms: one inexpensive narrow single bed in the rear-right bedroom with a plain slightly faded blanket; one worn small two-seat couch against a living-room wall; one compact used mini fridge in the kitchen's empty appliance bay; one small cheap desk and one simple separate chair in a living-room corner, with the existing laptop MOVED from the kitchen counter onto this desk; one inexpensive simple floor lamp beside the couch; one small plain wall clock; one cup on the kitchen counter, a small loaf of bread and cereal box beside it.

No rugs, plants, art, curtains, coffee tables, bedside tables, wardrobes, TV, extra seating, fancy bedding, full-size fridge, stove, second laptop, or additional decorative props. No furniture blocks a doorway, corridor, bathroom approach, or front entry. The sofa must be compact, the bedroom has only one bed, the furnishing quality should feel thrift-store and mismatched but usable. All furniture follows the source perspective and warm shaded illustrated game-art rendering. No people, animals, labels, pricing, HUD, logos or watermark. This is the OPTIONAL MODESTLY FURNISHED preset, not a fully decorated house.
